item.title: O’Rourke hat-trick powers Salthill Devon to easy win

item.title: Galway’s traffic now 71st worst in world
item.description: Galway is ranked the 71st worst city in the world for traffic congestion in a new global report published this week. item.title: Drugs haul in delivery to big city company
item.description: A Garda investigation into the importation of illegal drugs through an employee of a major company on the east side of the city has led to the arrest and questioning of one man.
